# DTLN-aec 128

The two ONNX models are from the local echo-cancel lab's conversion of
[DTLN-aec](https://github.com/breizhn/DTLN-aec), licensed under MIT (see LICENSE).
They were converted with tf2onnx 1.17, opset 17, and checked against TFLite to
5e-5. The two files form one 128-unit model pipeline.
